name: Box tools parity
ownerWords:
(10-18, goal p1) make us-metal02, the Linux box, match the owner's MacBook Pro for every tool, for auto-sns-agent and sieun-pi.

(10-18, relayed by the AI harness chat) things are meant to be first written in plan -> achieved ->  cleared & written on duty for maintanence only -> and valiantly persued whenever not met. JUST DO IT
goal: us-metal02 keeps matching the owner's MacBook Pro for every tool auto-sns-agent and sieun-pi agents use: each of the 167 audit rows has what the Mac has, in presence, version and a real call that works on the box. The box carries no resource cap the owner did not ask for (c107), the RCU boost watcher runs so a preempted RCU reader always runs again, and ssh on the box's public address stays closed outside the tailnet.

metrics.label: Tool rows where the box lacks what the Mac has (presence, version or a real call)
Memory, CPU, IO, task or priority settings on the box the owner did not ask for (c107)
The RCU boost watcher (CPU layer 3) is not running, or the kernel's RCU stall warning delay is not the one it sets
Port 22 answers on the box's public address, or the ssh guard is not loaded

onMiss: Fix every miss until the run is green, with one subagent per miss: one per tool_row_off item, one per resource_limit item and one for public_ssh_open and one for rcu_boost_off. Never only report. A version row with a `follow` recipe in box-parity.rows.json installs the Mac's version by itself before the rows are judged, and box-follow.timer runs it every 15 minutes; one still off shows a `followed` item with the install's error, so fix its recipe, or add a recipe to a version row that lacks one, instead of upgrading by hand. A tool row: read its item in the flagged list, make the box match the Mac (install or upgrade the CLI into ~/.local/bin without root, copy the config or credential from the Mac with its mode kept, restart the box unit, or fix the failing call), and re-run `node --import tsx scripts/duties/box-parity.ts` in sieun-pi legacy/prime/user-history to see the row match. A Mac value that is wrong and the box's right (an expired Mac login) asks nothing of the box. A resource limit: remove the setting from its unit, drop-in, systemd-run call or container config, with no replacement cap (c107), and reload or restart only that unit. rcu_boost_off: as root run `bash deploy/linux/cpu/setup-cpu.sh` from the sieun-pi checkout, which installs and restarts rcu-boost.service and sets rcu_cpu_stall_timeout, then read `journalctl -u rcu-boost` for why it stopped. public_ssh_open: reload deploy/linux/ssh-public-guard.nft through ssh-public-guard.service and find what removed it. A wrong check gets a fix with a test in sieun-pi (scripts/duties/box-parity.ts, box-parity-probe.py or box-parity.rows.json). Reach the Mac only with short timeout-wrapped `ssh mac` reads and copies, never start a session there, and never send anything outside. Only a password, 2FA or paid plan goes to the owner, as one For you item. A run that found the Mac offline on Tailscale reruns by itself once the Mac is back online, so never try to wake the Mac.
